instruction.text: Höre zu und lies mit. Beantworte anschließend die Fragen zu Paolas Ferien.

atoms.text: My holidays were amazing! One week I stayed at home with my family. My sister and I always played table tennis outside. That was fun! We also went for walks with our dog and explored the forest. The week after, I went to football camp with friends. We trained twice a day. When we weren't too tired, we went to a shop down the road. On the last day there was even a disco with nice music.
